name: Intel 8085 Binary Counter
desc: Intel 8085 - 8-bit binary counter on PB port. Outputs incrementing count (0-255) with visual LED pattern.
code:
; Intel 8085 - 8-bit Binary Counter on PB
; Connect 8 LEDs from PB.0-PB.7 to GND
; Each LED shows one bit of the counter

        MVI A, FFH       ; All PB pins = output
        OUT 00H           ; Configure PB direction
        MVI B, 00H       ; B = counter value

LOOP:   MOV A, B         ; Copy counter to A
        OUT 01H           ; Output to PB port
        INR B            ; Increment counter (wraps at 255)
        CALL DELAY        ; Wait between counts
        JMP LOOP

DELAY:  MVI D, 08H       ; Moderate delay
DL1:    MVI E, 0FFH
DL2:    DCR E
        JNZ DL2
        DCR D
        JNZ DL1
        RET
